title: USB3 SuperSpeed device link and protocol layer: LFPS training to U0, warm reset, DPH / DPP / TP framing with CRC5 / CRC32, sequence numbers with retry, NRDY and LBAD, IN retransmission, and bulk OUT / IN over a 4-block buffer

fields.desc: U0 reached (cleared by a warm reset); same as the link_up pin

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: bad DPP CRC32, bad DPH / TP CRC5, bad END, missing DPP, symbol decode error inside a packet, or an IN transfer given up after four attempts. Sticky in the core until PRESETN, so the bit is set again on every clock

notes: rx_p / rx_n (one 8-bit symbol per PCLK, rx_n = ~rx_p), tx_p / tx_n and link_up pass through unchanged. The device trains on its own after reset.
The bulk buffer is reached over the link only; the registers report the link state and errors.
